Who I am

About me

I’m pursuing a BS in Computer Applications, majoring in Embedded Systems, at MSU-IIT in Iligan City. I develop embedded prototypes for sensor monitoring and activity recognition.

My current research includes an ongoing, university-funded study on detecting aphid damage using edge AI and a systematic literature review on bell-pepper disease and pest monitoring.

My experience spans real-time embedded programming, digital fabrication, online English teaching, student government, and technology events. I hope to build on this foundation through research placements abroad and collaborative projects with practical applications.

Ideas into practice

My work

Eleven projects in embedded systems, software, and research.

Ongoing research

Aphid damage detection

An ongoing, university-funded study on detecting aphid damage in bell pepper plants (Capsicum annuum). Raspberry Pi 5 and YOLOv8n process images, while a Flask web interface shows the results and supports monitoring without an internet connection.

My role: Student researcher · Collaborative research

Tools: Raspberry Pi 5, YOLOv8n, Flask

Visit the research page

Prototype

RT-Spark activity recognition

An RT-Thread prototype that streams six-axis accelerometer and gyroscope data over Wi-Fi and MQTT/TLS to a cloud-based walking and running classifier. Python tools capture labeled readings and prepare sensor data for classification.

My role: Contributor · Sensor data collection & evaluation

Tools: RT-Thread, Python, MQTT/TLS

View GitHub repository

Simulated prototype

Real-time multisensor room monitor

An STM32 Blue Pill room monitor with FreeRTOS tasks for sensors, an OLED display, rotary-encoder input, motion monitoring, and temperature alarms. Queues, event groups, and a serial mutex coordinate the tasks; documentation covers 10 functional checks.

My role: Firmware development · STM32 & FreeRTOS

Tools: STM32 Blue Pill, FreeRTOS, OLED

View GitHub repositoryRead the Hackster write-up

More projects (8)

Desktop prototype

Smart Inventory Sorting System

A desktop prototype for creating, viewing, updating, and deleting product records, with account registration and login. Warehouse occupancy is updated manually across 12 areas.

My role: Co-developer · Desktop software prototype

Tools: C++17, Qt Widgets, SQLite

View GitHub repository

Arduino prototype

AquaFlush water-flow monitoring

An Arduino Uno prototype that estimates water flow by counting sensor pulses with interrupts. My work included programming, wiring the components, and helping build a miniature drainage model for demonstration.

My role: Arduino programming · Circuit integration

Tools: Arduino Uno, Interrupts, Flow sensing

View project repository

Simulated control system

Industrial drying oven control

A CODESYS simulation for drying metal fixtures containing heat-sensitive rubber O-rings. PLC logic and HMI screens manage temperature settings, door interlocks, status indicators, overheating alarms, and automatic shutdown.

My role: PLC logic & HMI development

Tools: CODESYS, PLC, HMI

Read project documentation

Circuit prototype

Touch-sensitive electronic coin tosser

A circuit developed through breadboard prototyping and PCB soldering, with 3D models and an animation made in Autodesk Fusion 360. Evaluation covered 50 trials across five potentiometer settings to check LED outputs and circuit behavior.

My role: Circuit prototyping · 3D modeling & evaluation

Tools: Circuit design, PCB soldering, Fusion 360

View project documentation

Hardware prototype

Line-following robot

An Arduino Uno (ATmega328P) robot that follows a line using two infrared sensors, an L298N motor driver, and DC motors. I built and documented the hardware.

My role: Hardware integration & documentation

Tools: Arduino Uno, ATmega328P, L298N

View project documentation

Coursework & simulation

AVR firmware & simulation

AVR assembly exercises covering register operations, stack management, coin-value calculations, and binary search. Work also includes ATmega328P digital inputs and outputs with hexadecimal mapping from 0 to F.

My role: AVR assembly programming & simulation

Tools: AVR assembly, ATmega328P, Microchip Studio

Read firmware project documentation

Embedded project

BrainBoard quiz game

A touchscreen quiz game built with RT-Thread and LVGL on the RA6M3. It combines quizzes, live scoring, and time tracking.

Tools: RA6M3, RT-Thread, LVGL

View the BrainBoard project

Embedded project

STM32 FreeRTOS audio player

An STM32F407 audio player that turns binary song selections into synthesized melodies using I2S and DMA. FreeRTOS keeps the playback controls responsive.

Tools: STM32F407, FreeRTOS, I2S, DMA
